craft_notes: Sthāyin: horizon-joy (till splendor). Sanskrit first: ground + wish + open yāvat → L4 sets ground line 1, wish+horizon line 2. Rows: row 1 (splendor-last — dyutiḥ closes as splendor closes). Rupture: colon after toil — ground done, wish released. Close: end-weight on splendor (the open word — no period-weight). Minimal pass: colon for L3 comma. Read aloud: unbroken, gathered, till... Rejected: closing the horizon ('forever bright') — killed: yāvat stays open; 'shine' verb for dyuti — kept? L4 noun splendor — noun kept (splendor as state).

lines: Unbroken in the I-self, gathered by his toil:
wake and stand in self, till Sadāśiva-splendor.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ahamātmany asambhinnaḥ saṃgṛhya svaprayatnataḥ / prabuddhaḥ syāt svaniṣṭhaḥ san yāvat sādāśivadyutiḥ

reads_against.argmap: Unbroken in the I-self, gathered by own effort — awakened, grounded, till Sadāśiva-splendor.
c1_essence: Unbroken in I-self, own effort: awakened till Sadāśiva-splendor.
